components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main assessment action with a restrained radius and tactile bottom edge.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; border: 1px solid rgba(31, 35, 40, 0.15); border-radius: 6px; padding: 0 18px; color: #fff; background: var(--accent-emphasis, #1f6feb); box-shadow: 0 3px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent-emphasis, #1f6feb) 72%, #000); font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 650; cursor: pointer; } .ds-button-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 4px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent-emphasis, #1f6feb) 72%, #000); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent, #0969da); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A bordered canvas action for secondary navigation and plan export.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; border: 1px solid var(--border, #d1d9e0); border-radius: 6px; padding: 0 18px; color: var(--fg, #1f2328); background: var(--canvas, #fff); font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 650; cursor: pointer; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--accent, #0969da); color: var(--accent, #0969da); } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent, #0969da); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Question Card
components.description: A square evidence field with a numbered legend and structural bottom edge.
components.html:
1Is delegation bounded by documented policy?

Choose the answer supported by evidence today.
components.css: .ds-question-card { min-width: 0; margin: 0; border: 1px solid var(--border, #d1d9e0); padding: 26px; color: var(--fg, #1f2328); background: var(--canvas, #fff); box-shadow: 0 3px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--border, #d1d9e0) 60%, transparent); font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-question-card legend { display: flex; gap: 12px; align-items: center; padding-right: 10px; font-size: 20px; letter-spacing: -0.015em; } .ds-question-card legend span { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 28px; height: 28px; border: 1px solid var(--border, #d1d9e0); border-radius: 50%; color: var(--fg-muted, #59636e); font-size: 13px; } .ds-question-card p { margin: 6px 0 0 40px; color: var(--fg-muted, #59636e); line-height: 1.6; }

components.name: Selected Response Option
components.description: A selected evidence response with a circular value marker and inset confirmation edge.
components.css: .ds-response-option { position: relative; display: block; cursor: pointer; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-response-option input { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; opacity: 0; } .ds-response-option span { min-height: 58px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 28px minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 9px; align-items: center; border: 1px solid var(--accent, #0969da); padding: 9px 10px; color: var(--accent, #0969da); background: var(--accent-muted, #ddf4ff); box-shadow: inset 0 -3px 0 var(--accent, #0969da); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 650; } .ds-response-option b { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 27px; height: 27px; border-radius: 50%; color: #fff; background: var(--accent-emphasis, #1f6feb); } .ds-response-option input:focus-visible + span { outline: 3px solid var(--accent, #0969da); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Sticky Progress Dock
components.description: A compact orientation aid combining answered count, progress rail, and results link.
components.css: .ds-progress-dock { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto minmax(140px, 1fr) auto; gap: 18px; align-items: center; border: 1px solid var(--border, #d1d9e0); padding: 12px 16px; color: var(--fg, #1f2328); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--canvas, #fff) 95%, transparent); box-shadow: var(--shadow, 0 8px 24px rgba(140, 149, 159, 0.16)); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-progress-dock > div:first-child { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 7px; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-progress-dock span, .ds-progress-dock a { color: var(--fg-muted, #59636e); font-size: 13px; } .ds-progress-dock a { color: var(--accent, #0969da); font-weight: 650; text-decoration: none; } .ds-progress-track { height: 6px; overflow: hidden; background: var(--canvas-inset, #eff2f5); } .ds-progress-track span { display: block; width: 46%; height: 100%; background: var(--accent-emphasis, #1f6feb); } .ds-progress-dock a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent, #0969da); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Active Matrix Cell
components.description: The current Stock-Adoption quadrant, shown within a ruled two-axis field.
components.html:

Continue expanding participation with outcome evidence.
components.css: .ds-matrix-cell { min-height: 230px; border: 1px solid var(--border, #d1d9e0); padding: 40px; color: var(--accent, #0969da); background: var(--accent-muted, #ddf4ff); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 3px var(--accent, #0969da); font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-matrix-cell span { color: var(--fg-muted, #59636e); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-matrix-cell strong { display: block; max-width: 24ch; margin-top: 18px; font-size: 30px; line-height: 1.08; letter-spacing: -0.025em; } .ds-matrix-cell p { max-width: 54ch; margin: 14px 0 0; color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #0969da) 65%, var(--fg, #1f2328)); line-height: 1.55; }

components.name: Header Navigation
components.description: A sticky translucent GitHub-native header with compact links and bordered icon control.
components.html: AssessmentResults
components.css: .ds-header-nav { min-height: 64px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 18px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border, #d1d9e0); padding: 10px 24px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--canvas, #fff) 92%, transparent); backdrop-filter: blur(14px); font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-header-nav a { color: var(--fg-muted, #59636e); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; } .ds-header-nav a:hover { color: var(--fg, #1f2328); } .ds-header-nav button { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 36px; height: 36px; border: 1px solid var(--border, #d1d9e0); border-radius: 6px; color: var(--fg, #1f2328); background: var(--canvas, #fff); cursor: pointer; } .ds-header-nav button:hover { border-color: var(--accent, #0969da); color: var(--accent, #0969da); } .ds-header-nav a:focus-visible, .ds-header-nav button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent, #0969da); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Source Row
components.description: A full-width source link structured as category, title, and external destination.

narrative.overview:
The system presents readiness as a connected operating model rather than a dashboard score. GitHub-native neutrals, one-pixel rules, direct typography, and source links create a technical field guide that supports both reading and operating. Large statements establish the consequence of the work, while evidence controls, the Stock-Adoption matrix, and the preparation plan make the model actionable.

The visual voice is crisp, source-forward, and restrained. Violet, blue, and green identify the three AES stocks without turning the page into a multicolor dashboard. Dense assessment content stays legible through strong hierarchy, long reading measures, visible borders, and responsive reflow.
keyCharacteristics: GitHub-native light and dark neutral surfaces.
Strong editorial headings paired with practical evidence text.
Crisp rules and square field structures instead of rounded dashboard cards.
Three stock colors with stable semantic roles.
System diagrams and matrices that explain relationships, not isolated metrics.
Public sources and local-data assurances placed in the reading flow.

rules.name: The Three Stocks Rule
rules.body: Keep violet, blue, and green bound to governance, shared knowledge, and customer value. Do not reassign them for decoration.

rules.name: The Neutral Field Rule
rules.body: Let neutral canvases and rules carry most of the interface. Color marks meaning, state, or action.

rules.name: The Operational Promise Rule
rules.body: Use the largest type for consequential statements about the system. Do not spend display scale on ornamental labels or raw scores.

rules.name: The Connected Field Rule
rules.body: Prefer adjacent regions separated by shared one-pixel rules over collections of detached cards.

rules.name: The Hero Grid Is Local Rule
rules.body: The 32px grid and concentric rings belong only to the circular system-map visual. They are not a page background, section texture, or reusable panel treatment.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Use rules and tonal separation first. Add elevation only when an element floats, remains sticky, or represents a framed system object.

rules.name: The Circle Means System Rule
rules.body: Use circles for stocks, cycles, markers, and bounded positions. Keep reading containers rectilinear.

dos: Do use crisp one-pixel rules and GitHub-neutral surfaces to structure long reading flows.
Do keep stock colors bound to governance, shared knowledge, and customer value.
Do pair large operational headings with muted source-forward explanations.
Do collapse multi-column evidence controls into a clear single-column mobile flow.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Don't turn the hero's 32px grid into a general page background or reusable panel texture.
Don't replace the connected field with detached KPI cards or a generic metrics dashboard.
Don't round major reading containers, matrices, warnings, or evidence groups.
Don't use color without a text label, structural position, or state cue.
Don't add ambient shadows to every card.
